title.description: Human title without the ADR id prefix.

date.description: Date from the status line when known.

binding.description: True when the ADR constrains future implementation.

gate.description: Named consuming-repo verification gate, if any.

documents_shipped.description: True when this ADR documents behavior already shipped before authoring.

verified_in.description: Local evidence pointers such as file paths, symbols, tests, or commits.

superseded_by.description: Successor ADR id when this ADR is superseded.

format.description: Optional ADR body profile discriminator. Legacy records may omit it and are detected from headings.

topics.description: Optional deterministic topic terms for selective ADR retrieval.

aliases.description: Optional alternative names and phrases for selective ADR retrieval.

components.description: Optional architectural components named by this decision.

symbols.description: Optional code symbols named by this decision.

context_scope.description: Whether the ADR is baseline context or requires positive selective evidence.
